links.outcome: LLM abstraction error rates against human-abstracted reference data, single LLM versus dual-LLM consensus
links.effect: Pathology: consensus LLM median error 0.09% vs individual LLMs 0.27% and 0.30%, human 2.81%. MRI: consensus 0.17% vs individual 0.84% and 1.02%, human 1.01%.
links.quote: LLM data abstraction employing a consensus vote across two independent LLMs consistently yielded higher accuracy than human or single-LLM abstraction.

unlisted_practices: Dual-LLM consensus voting to reduce data abstraction errors in registry curation
